instruction: A candid outdoor full shot from a low angle shows an intimate moment. On the left, the woman in the white long-sleeved dress (R1) leans against a white stone wall beneath a black ornate metal fence, smiling up at her partner. On the right, the man in the patterned short-sleeved shirt (R2) stands close, facing her with his hand in his pocket. They share a close, affectionate gaze in the bright daylight.
